entries.claim: The pinned wrapper contains two separate printed chants. This use addresses only the graduale body at the stated lines; its exact accidental differences are preserved.
The directly viewed Benziger page prints this graduale separately, with exactly 24 words. The neighboring chant and subsequent Paschal pair are not part of this component.
